description: Changes a product at once (no neblla_promote): pass only what changes; its productId never changes. Moves no money: a new price, interval or trial applies to new subscribers only. null removes stock, shipping, content, seller, tokens or repeatable. Deleting: neblla_delete_product.

anyOf.description: PRIVATE CONTENT the buyer gets beside its files

content.description: The private links or texts, replacing the list; null or [] removes them.

defaultLang.description: The language of a plain-string name and description.

description.description: A string, or one per language.

image.description: An https URL of its picture.

name.description: A string, or one per language.

price.description: one_time, subscription (per period): the price, in cents.

pricePerUnit.description: consumable: the price of one unit.

productId.description: The product's id or the name the app's code uses.

repeatable.description: one_time: true lets the same user buy it again; false or null: once.

seller.description: "site:<id>" or "user:<id>"; null: the app's payout account.

shipping.description: The zones, replacing them all; null: no longer physical.

stock.description: Units for sale in all; null: no limit. Units sold stay sold.

stockRefundReturns.description: A refunded unit goes back on sale.

tokens.description: Tokens each unit gives; null: no longer a pack.

name: neblla_update_product
title: Edit a product
